entries.title: Proverbs 7:1
segments: ¶My son, keep my words, and lay up my commandments with thee.

entries.title: Proverbs 7:2
segments: Keep my commandments, and live; and my teaching, as the apple of thine eye.

entries.title: Proverbs 7:3
segments: Bind them upon thy fingers, write them upon the tablet of thy heart.

entries.title: Proverbs 7:4
segments: Say unto wisdom, Thou art my sister, and call intelligence [thy] kinswoman:

entries.title: Proverbs 7:5
segments: that they may keep thee from the strange woman, from the stranger who flattereth with her words.

entries.title: Proverbs 7:6
segments: ¶For at the window of my house, I looked forth through my lattice,

entries.title: Proverbs 7:7
segments: and I beheld among the simple ones, I discerned among the sons, a young man void of understanding,

entries.title: Proverbs 7:8
segments: passing through the street near her corner; and he went the way to her house,

entries.title: Proverbs 7:9
segments: in the twilight, in the evening of the day, in the blackness of night and the darkness.

entries.title: Proverbs 7:10
segments: And behold, there met him a woman in the attire of a harlot, and subtle of heart.

entries.title: Proverbs 7:11
segments: She is clamorous and unmanageable; her feet abide not in her house:

entries.title: Proverbs 7:12
segments: now without, now in the broadways, --and she lieth in wait at every corner.

entries.title: Proverbs 7:13
segments: And she caught him and kissed him, and with an impudent face said unto him,

entries.title: Proverbs 7:14
segments: I have peace-offerings with me; this day have I paid my vows:

entries.title: Proverbs 7:15
segments: therefore came I forth to meet thee, to seek earnestly thy face, and I have found thee.

entries.title: Proverbs 7:16
segments: I have decked my bed with tapestry coverlets of variegated linen from Egypt;

entries.title: Proverbs 7:17
segments: I have perfumed my couch with myrrh, aloes, and cinnamon.

entries.title: Proverbs 7:18
segments: Come, let us revel in love until the morning, let us delight ourselves with loves.

entries.title: Proverbs 7:19
segments: For the husband is not at home, he is gone a long journey;

entries.title: Proverbs 7:20
segments: he hath taken the money-bag with him, he will come home on the day of the full moon.

entries.title: Proverbs 7:21
segments: With her much enticement she beguiled him; with the smoothness of her lips she constrained him.

entries.title: Proverbs 7:22
segments: He went after her straightway, as an ox goeth to the slaughter, and as stocks [serve] for the correction of the fool;

entries.title: Proverbs 7:23
segments: till an arrow strike through his liver: as a bird hasteth to the snare, and knoweth not that it is for its life.

entries.title: Proverbs 7:24
segments: ¶And now, ye sons, hearken unto me, and attend to the words of my mouth.

entries.title: Proverbs 7:25
segments: Let not thy heart decline to her ways, go not astray in her paths:

entries.title: Proverbs 7:26
segments: for she hath cast down many wounded, and all slain by her were strong.

entries.title: Proverbs 7:27
segments: Her house is the way to Sheol, going down to the chambers of death.
